name: M7.GlobalQuery.empty_objectives
statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N), q.objectives = [] → M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases = M7.Selection.feasibleSet Finset.univ (M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases)
guidance: Instantiate accepted Selection.empty_objectives after destructuring/replacing Query.objectives so its dependent Fin length is zero. Keep all global feasible indices. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.
